newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Hambrecht & Quist cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hambrecht & Quist cut.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley says it downgraded Hambrecht & Quist Inc to neutral from outperform.
-- Additional details were not immediately available.
-- Morgan Stanley later cited Hambrecht & Quist's expected weak earnings for the downgrade.
-- said it expects Hambrecht & Quist to earn $0.28 a share in the March quarter. Expects earnings of $1.80 a share in 1997 and $2.05 a share in 1998.
-- said expected earnings weakness relates to the downturn in the technology sector.

-- said the recent weakness in technology stocks, especially small capitalization stocks, has had a ripple effect on Hambrecht & Quist's underwriting business. The drop in technology stocks also cut into some revenues from certain venture capital partnerships.
-- said technology represents about half of underlying business.
